startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Public government site pages to start from. The crawler stays on the same domain and always respects robots.txt.

maxPagesPerCrawl.title: Max pages
maxPagesPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of HTML pages to visit.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: How many links deep to follow from the start URLs. 0 = process only the start URLs (useful when you already have a list of service pages, e.g. from Website Content Crawler). Empty = unlimited.

extractPdfFields.title: Extract PDF form fields
extractPdfFields.description: Download linked PDF forms (only when robots.txt allows) and extract their fillable field names and first-page text.

maxPdfs.title: Max PDFs
maxPdfs.description: Maximum number of PDF forms to download and parse.

excludeUrlGlobs.title: Exclude URL globs
excludeUrlGlobs.description: Links matching these globs are not crawled as pages (PDF form links are still recorded).
